title: Material for MkDocs markdown extensions
description: The Markdown extensions the Material for MkDocs theme builds upon, as listed under markdown_extensions.

id.description: The identifier as it appears under markdown_extensions, for example pymdownx.superfences.

pipPackage.description: The PyPI package providing the extension. Absent if Python Markdown itself ships it.

level.description: How strongly the extension is tied to the configuration of the site.

descriptionKey.description: The bundle key of the one line description shown in QuickDoc and in the settings page.

docUrl.description: The address of the documentation of the extension, offered as a link in QuickDoc.

defaultOptions.description: The options the quick fix writes below the extension when it adds it, in order.

value.description: The value written for the option, verbatim.

iconShorthand.description: Whether this extension is the one the icon and emoji shorthands of the theme need.
